I'm checking the overview's claims one by one. The first, that account pages failed for shoppers with no purchases this month, is backed by the "what a reader saw" and "why" sections. The peak error rate figures are supported too. The third claim, about a software update removing a safeguard, is supported as well. I'm now on the fourth, about a new account-page feature being switched on at the same moment.

I'm going through the rest of the overview claims: the simultaneous feature switch-on is backed by matching timestamps, and the lost-sales estimate and the lack of paging are supported. I'm also checking that the rollback attempt, the spending-feature shutoff, and the proposed fix in PR #568 match what the logs show, with the fix still a draft.

content.text:
I found nothing to flag in the overview. Each of its claims is backed by the record.

- **"Permanent fix" (PR #568):** this wording goes a little beyond the record, which only calls it "a fix". I let it stand because the overview is plain-words, it doesn't say the fix was applied, and it says outright that it is still a draft.
- **"Tried to roll back":** the record shows Argus picked the rollback first and the deployment platform refused the request (it couldn't be reached). I counted that as trying, so I didn't flag it.

supported.quote: For {duration}, io-shop's account pages failed to load for shoppers who had not bought anything so far this month.
rows: What a reader saw: Shoppers' account pages failed to load

supported.quote: At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests failed.
rows: Requests failing at the worst minute: 36.0% {peak_error_rate}

supported.quote: The cause was a software update that removed a safeguard for these shoppers.
A new account-page feature was switched on at the same moment, and without the safeguard, the page's monthly spending calculation failed for them.
Argus estimates the lost sales at {customer_loss}.
rows: What it cost the shop in takings (estimated by Argus): 4,234.52 USD {customer_loss}

supported.quote: Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one.
rows: Nobody was paged: no on-call incident was linked to this one.

supported.quote: Argus tried to roll back the io-shop software update, but it couldn't reach the platform, so nothing was changed.
rows: Argus: did not roll back the deployment of io-shop - platform-unreachable, nothing was changed

supported.quote: Argus then switched off the new monthly spending feature (the feature flag monthly-spend-feature). That change is confirmed and still in place.
rows: Argus: reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature - confirmed, still in place

supported.quote: Argus has also proposed a permanent fix, PR #568, which is still a draft and has not been applied.
rows: Argus: proposed a fix, PR #568 - opened as a draft
